summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 58 ('ipns-signature-verify-coverage') of the CipherBox project — adding IPNS signature verification as a hard-enforcement chokepoint across Rust (crates/core, crates/fuse) and TypeScript (sdk-core, web) layers, with 4 plans in 2 waves using TDD mode.
summary.outcome: Phase 58 completed fully: all 4 plans executed, 7/7 verifier must-haves confirmed in code, all test suites green (cargo core 75, fuse 87, api jest 913/913, sdk-core vitest 243, SDK E2E 89/89), code-review findings applied, and phase marked complete in STATE.md/ROADMAP.md.

repo: crates/crypto cannot dev-depend on api-client/core, so cross-language verify vectors belong in crates/fuse/tests/ not crates/crypto/tests/ — a real dependency-cycle constraint the planner caught

API .env TEST_LOGIN_SECRET is 'e2e-test-secret-ci-only' but SDK E2E default SDK_E2E_SECRET is 'e2e-test-secret-do-not-use-in-production' — mismatched env causes test-login 401s and silently skips the E2E suite
RESEARCH.md '## Open Questions' heading must be annotated '(RESOLVED)' after planning or plan-checker emits a cosmetic warning
gsd 'phase complete' helper reports commit_failed as a known false negative — verify via git log rather than retrying

D-09 gate (non-CAS embedded-sequence enforcement) in upsertFolderIpns uses an idempotent branch: no-increment but update latestCid; the CAS expectedSequenceNumber guard at line 245 is intentionally separate
This D-09 tightening class previously broke 48/89 SDK E2E tests — treat any change to upsertFolderIpns/publish path as high-risk and require full SDK E2E gate before marking complete
5 REQ-IDs (IPNS-05/06, DB-01/02, BYO-08) are absent from the traceability table — pre-existing hygiene debt unrelated to HARD-09

code.finding: ciborium is a direct dependency of the fuse crate — the executor's mid-crash diagnostic claiming it was missing was stale/incorrect
Had unchecked seq + 1 arithmetic (WR-01 from code review) while the rest of the crate uses checked_add — fixed during post-verification review application

workflow: Sequential execution on the feature branch is safer than worktree-parallel isolation for security/crypto phases — avoids merge failures and cwd-drift at the cost of wall-clock time
Run SDK E2E gate via a focused subagent with full harness context rather than inline — the test-login payload shape and env wiring are non-obvious and fail silently with wrong credentials
Apply advisory code-review findings on security phases before marking complete even after the verifier passes — the incremental cost is low and findings directly strengthen the hardening
An executor subagent can overrun its plan boundary and execute the next plan in the same agent run — track what actually landed in git by commit rather than by what you dispatched
A socket-dropped executor leaves partial work uncommitted; diagnose via git diff before spawning a continuation to avoid duplicating completed tasks

friction: 58-01 executor lost its API socket connection mid-execution, leaving Task 3 (FUSE routing) done but uncommitted and Task 4 (sdk-core binding) not started — required a manual continuation subagent
SDK E2E gate silently skipped during 58-02 execution due to TEST_LOGIN_SECRET mismatch — executor labeled it 'infra-limited' rather than failing loudly, masking the gap until a dedicated re-run
58-02 executor overran into 58-03 and executed both plans in a single agent run — useful outcome but unexpected and makes it hard to reason about plan boundaries
gsd commit helper emits false commit_failed signals requiring git log verification after every phase-tracking commit
test-login endpoint payload shape is undocumented — probing :3000 manually with curl returned 400s rather than the expected 401/200, making the credential mismatch hard to diagnose inline
open_items: TEST_LOGIN_SECRET / SDK_E2E_SECRET env mismatch should be aligned across API .env and SDK E2E defaults to prevent future silent E2E skips
5 pre-existing missing REQ-IDs in traceability table (IPNS-05/06, DB-01/02, BYO-08) — unblocking hygiene work deferred
Source todos lacked resolves_phase: 58 tag so the auto-closer skipped them; they were manually moved to completed/ — consider tagging todos with phase refs at creation time
replay.rs checked_add pattern should be audited in sibling crates for the same unchecked arithmetic (WR-01 was fixed here but the pattern may exist elsewhere)
